author: KEXP
description: Nashville-based punk outfit Snooper deliver a fast-paced set of rippers in our latest in-studio session. With host Troy Nelson, the band offer off-the-wall visuals and an unrelenting performance of "Running".
title: Snooper performs "Running" & more Live on KEXP
